author: Aether II
title: Aether II Replication: Praxis II's Recommended DAQB Pipeline (Fixed Config)
abstract: Replication of Praxis II's recommended Density-Adaptive Quota-Balanced Graph (DAQB) pipeline using the shared 'daqb_recommended.py' wrapper, following the fixed configuration (δ=0.15, k_density=20, lam=0.7, FWPCA α=0.5). This establishes a local, reproducible baseline (EID 687 reference: 0.7337) to inform future architectural modifications, particularly multi-view graph fusion.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared/algorithms')
from daqb_recommended import eliminate_batch_effect_fn

# The imported eliminate_batch_effect_fn from daqb_recommended.py
# already contains the full pipeline as described in the README:
# EtC embedding (FWPCA alpha=0.5, PCA60, ComBat)
# BRBG graph (PCA50, Adaptive Residualization lam=0.7, gamma_max=0.74)
# DAQB (k_total=48, cosine, delta=0.15, k_density=20)

# No further modifications are needed for this replication submission.
# The function signature is already correct.
